Comments (English): [ Dryer is from Shinsegae, dishwasher is from Shinsegae Main Store ] || ---------------- || After cervical disc surgery, standing at the kitchen counter for long periods of time or bending over to wash dishes became incredibly difficult. Especially as my children grew, the dishes and cutlery I used each day began to pile up, not just for one or two meals, but for several. Doing the dishes once a day became impossible, and my back pain worsened, making it difficult for the whole family. So, I purchased the LG DUE6BGL3E. It has a large capacity for 14 people and is built-in, so it sits neatly under the sink, maximizing space and keeping the kitchen feeling organized. The stainless steel interior reduces odors and is highly hygienic. The powerful steam sterilization function, along with the automatic door opening and hot air drying, ensures that dishes are thoroughly dried after each wash. I was also very satisfied with the dishwashing performance. I even put chili powder, oil, and traces of tteokguk soup in my soup bowl without soaking them, and most of them were cleaned cleanly. Thanks to the high-temperature cleaning and cooling function, there was virtually no oil or food odor left behind, leaving me feeling refreshed the next time I used it. The noise level is relatively low, so it doesn't significantly disturb the family's rest or sleep, even during quiet mornings or evenings. The automatic door opens after drying, minimizing odor and quickly removing moisture from the interior, making it feel hygienic. The combination of steam sterilization and hot air makes it even more reliable. It's also incredibly user-friendly. The hidden, clean, and intuitive front touch control panel is a nice touch. The remaining time display allows you to see how much time is left during operation, and the mid-load feature allows you to add plates and cutlery during the wash cycle, which is also very useful. Ultimately, this appliance helps reduce neck and back strain after cervical disc surgery and significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes due to children's increased use of dishes. Water consumption is also around 14-15L, making it quite economical compared to a 14-person dishwasher. Its top-tier energy efficiency rating also means less worries about electricity bills. If you want a clean and hygienic kitchen, the DUE6BGL3E will be a truly satisfying choice! If you found this article helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher arrived securely boxed and wrapped.
Comments (English): [ Customer service was great ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher arrived securely boxed and wrapped. All of the attachments were either hooked to the back of the dishwasher or were inside. The only part not included is the hot water hose, which I already had from the prior dishwasher. The dishwasher uses a standard three-pronged power cord as opposed to being hardwired. Installation was straightforward and the instruction guide was helpful, using QR codes for additional help if needed. Initially, a red blinking light on the bottom right of the dishwasher indicated some sort of issue needing attention. I went through several different troubleshooting suggestions; however, nothing worked and the red light continued to blink. Due to it being a Sunday, customer service was not available; however, the next morning I was easily able to reach a Bosch customer service agent. The agent was able to walk me through resetting the dishwasher step by step in a clear, easy to understand manner and within minutes, the dishwasher was working. It's important to note a flashing red light indicates a problem. A solid red light means the dishwasher is working and it will remain red until the cycle is over. The dishwasher is very quiet and the buttons require a light touch to activate. The buttons are along the top of the dishwasher and the front has a flat, sleek profile. The dishwasher is wifi enabled so you can access the dishwasher via an app you can download if you choose. Overall, it is a very simple installation and a very quiet machine.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Sentence (English): Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Sentence (English): Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing!
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Sentence (English): Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Sentence (English): Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, pros and cons, and some usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's a window-mounted unit, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-family homes or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit simpler than a standard window-mounted air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic dishwashing. This reduces residual moisture and odor. Compact yet efficient storage for 3 people. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems to be quite noisy! It's similar to a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a burden. The cleaning power may be limited for heavy food ingredients. UV-based products seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers. Maintenance and consumables management are essential, including UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition inspections. These require self-maintenance. English: Consideration of electricity bill and usage time is required. Power consumption may be high when using a UV lamp + hot air dryer, so users who are sensitive to changes in electricity bills after a single use should be careful. Overall rating Ease of installation: (Self-installation possible, little space constraints) Sterilization/drying performance: (Excellent UV-centered hygiene, minimizes water stains and odor) Cleaning power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria) Mobility: (Easy to attach and detach as it is fixed to the window) Cost-effectiveness: (Inexpensive for its functionality, suitable for flat-rate users) Recommended for: Single people, 1-2 person households, newlyweds in the early stages of marriage Those who want to easily organize small dishes with a focus on environmental hygiene Users who prioritize installation and mobility Summary of usage tips 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation 2. It is recommended to wash oily food or large pots in advance before putting them in 3. Maintain hygiene by appropriately using the UV lamp and drying function 4. Regular internal cleaning and filter maintenance (including automatic door opening hinge inspection) Overall rating Blends well with kitchen interior: Thanks to its clean white design, it can be placed in a small kitchen without any visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it 2-3 times a day will make organizing dishes easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: It can be disassembled and moved by yourself without any plumbing, so it is highly recommended for those considering subleasing or moving frequently!

Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Sentence (English): Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner.
Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, along with pros, cons, and usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, along with pros, cons, and usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

Sentence (English): For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult.
Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, along with pros, cons, and usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

Sentence (English): For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene.
Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, along with pros, cons, and usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

Comments (English): This is a review of the Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher for 3 People. I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and got to try out the dishwasher. After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, along with pros, cons, and usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

After installing and using it, I'll share my experience, along with pros, cons, and usage tips. [Pros] Self-installation, virtually no space restrictions. Because it's window-mounted, anyone can install it as long as the size (space) fits without any plumbing! It's perfect for single-person or studio apartments, and its easy portability is a major advantage. Installation seems a bit easier than a standard window air conditioner. UV sterilization + high-temperature drying function. UV-C LED sterilizes the interior and automatically opens the door. It also dries in hot air and blower modes, ensuring hygienic results. It reduces residual moisture and odor. Its compact design for 3 people offers efficient storage. The two-tiered tray allows for organized arrangement of plates, cups, and utensils. Based on daily meal preparations, it should be able to accommodate 3 people. [Cons] (Personal opinion) It seems quite noisy! It's about the same size as a washing machine. Using it late at night might be a problem. Cleaning power may not be suitable for heavy dishes. UV-based dishwashers, compared to standard, high-pressure dishwashers, seem to have limitations when it comes to cleaning greasy frying pans or large pots. Consumables and Maintenance: Maintenance factors include UV lamp lifespan, filter cleaning cycles, and automatic door hinge condition. Self-maintenance is required. Consider electricity bills and usage time. Power consumption can be high when using the UV lamp and hot air dryer, so caution is advised if you're sensitive to fluctuations in electricity bills. Overall Rating: Ease of Installation: (Self-installation possible, minimal space constraints). Sterilization/Drying Performance: (UV-based hygiene, minimal water stains and odors). Cleaning Power: (Optimal for light dishes, effective for removing bacteria). Portability: (Window-mounted for easy attachment and detachment). Value for Money: (Inexpensive for its features, suitable for fixed-price users). Recommended for: Single-person households, one- or two-person households, and newlyweds in their early years. For studio apartments and apartments where plumbing installation is difficult. For those who want a simple way to organize small dishes with a focus on hygiene. For those who prioritize self-installation and portability. Summary of usage tips: 1. Accurately measure the window size and window frame width before installation. 2. Pre-wash greasy or large pots before use. 3. Properly use the UV lamp and drying function to maintain hygiene. 4. Regularly clean the interior and maintain the filter (including checking the automatic door hinge). Overall Review: Blends well with your kitchen interior: The clean white design makes it easy to place in even a small kitchen without visual burden. Useful for those living alone or in the early stages of marriage: Using it two to three times a day will make dish organization easier and reduce the stress of washing dishes. Useful for those who move frequently: Because it can be disassembled and moved without plumbing, it's highly recommended for those considering subletting or frequent moves!

Sentence (English): After having neck disc surgery, standing at the counter for long periods or bending over to wash dishes became extremely difficult.
Comments (English): [ Dryers are from Shinsegae, dishwashers are from Shinsegae Main Store ] || ---------------- || After having neck disc surgery, standing at the counter for long periods or bending over to wash dishes became extremely difficult. In particular, as my children grew older, the dishes and cutlery used each day started piling up—enough for multiple meals rather than just one or two. The dishes piled up to the point where washing them only once a day was simply unmanageable, and as my back pain worsened, it was a struggle for the whole family. That is why I purchased the LG DUE6BGL3E. This product is a large-capacity 14-place setting model, and since it is a built-in type, it is neatly embedded inside the sink cabinet, making excellent use of space and giving the kitchen a tidy feel. Because the interior is made of stainless steel (metal), it retains odors less and is very hygienic. Along with a powerful steam sterilization function, it features automatic door opening and hot air drying, ensuring that dishes dry cleanly without any water residue after washing. I was also very satisfied with the washing performance. I put things like chili powder, oil, and traces of rice cake soup broth directly into the soup bowls without soaking them first, and most of them were cleaned thoroughly. Thanks to the high-temperature washing and cooling functions, almost no grease or food odors remained, so the dishes felt fresh the next time I took them out. The noise level is relatively low, so it does not significantly disturb the family's rest or sleep, even during quiet mornings or evenings. Thanks to the automatic door opening, there is minimal odor after drying, and internal moisture evaporates quickly, making it feel hygienic. The combination of steam sterilization and hot air gives me even more confidence. Convenience of use is also excellent. The front touch control panel features a hidden style for a sleek look, and the buttons are intuitive. The remaining time display function, which allows you to check how much time is left at a glance, was very useful, and the mid-wash dish loading function, which allows you to add plates or cutlery even during the wash cycle, was also very helpful. In conclusion, this is an appliance that relieves strain on the neck and back after neck disc surgery and significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes caused by the increased use of children's dishes. Water consumption is around 14–15 liters, making it quite economical compared to a 14-place setting model, and with a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, you can worry less about electricity bills. Summary of reasons for recommendation: Relieves back strain: Automatic washing and drying instead of hand washing. Handles large families: Handles large volumes of children's dishes in one go. High hygiene: Steam sterilization + high-temperature washing + automatic door opening drying. Maximized convenience: Touch controls, intermediate loading, smartphone control. Quiet and clean finish: Low noise + water-free drying. Freed from dishwashing, it has become easier to spend time with my children, and the strain on my neck and back has been reduced. If you want a clean kitchen and a hygienic lifestyle, the DUE6BGL3E seems like a truly satisfying choice! If my post was helpful, please press the 'Helpful' button.

Comments (English): [ Dryers are from Shinsegae, dishwashers are from Shinsegae Main Store ] || ---------------- || After having neck disc surgery, standing at the counter for long periods or bending over to wash dishes became extremely difficult. In particular, as my children grew older, the dishes and cutlery used each day started piling up—enough for multiple meals rather than just one or two. The dishes piled up to the point where washing them only once a day was simply unmanageable, and as my back pain worsened, it was a struggle for the whole family. That is why I purchased the LG DUE6BGL3E. This product is a large-capacity 14-place setting model, and since it is a built-in type, it is neatly embedded inside the sink cabinet, making excellent use of space and giving the kitchen a tidy feel. Because the interior is made of stainless steel (metal), it retains odors less and is very hygienic. Along with a powerful steam sterilization function, it features automatic door opening and hot air drying, ensuring that dishes dry cleanly without any water residue after washing. I was also very satisfied with the washing performance. I put things like chili powder, oil, and traces of rice cake soup broth directly into the soup bowls without soaking them first, and most of them were cleaned thoroughly. Thanks to the high-temperature washing and cooling functions, almost no grease or food odors remained, so the dishes felt fresh the next time I took them out. The noise level is relatively low, so it does not significantly disturb the family's rest or sleep, even during quiet mornings or evenings. Thanks to the automatic door opening, there is minimal odor after drying, and internal moisture evaporates quickly, making it feel hygienic. The combination of steam sterilization and hot air gives me even more confidence. Convenience of use is also excellent. The front touch control panel features a hidden style for a sleek look, and the buttons are intuitive. The remaining time display function, which allows you to check how much time is left at a glance, was very useful, and the mid-wash dish loading function, which allows you to add plates or cutlery even during the wash cycle, was also very helpful. In conclusion, this is an appliance that relieves strain on the neck and back after neck disc surgery and significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes caused by the increased use of children's dishes. Water consumption is around 14–15 liters, making it quite economical compared to a 14-place setting model, and with a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, you can worry less about electricity bills. Summary of reasons for recommendation: Relieves back strain: Automatic washing and drying instead of hand washing. Handles large families: Handles large volumes of children's dishes in one go. High hygiene: Steam sterilization + high-temperature washing + automatic door opening drying. Maximized convenience: Touch controls, intermediate loading, smartphone control. Quiet and clean finish: Low noise + water-free drying. Freed from dishwashing, it has become easier to spend time with my children, and the strain on my neck and back has been reduced. If you want a clean kitchen and a hygienic lifestyle, the DUE6BGL3E seems like a truly satisfying choice! If my post was helpful, please press the 'Helpful' button.

Comments (English): [ Dryers are from Shinsegae, dishwashers are from Shinsegae Main Store ] || ---------------- || After having neck disc surgery, standing at the counter for long periods or bending over to wash dishes became extremely difficult. In particular, as my children grew older, the dishes and cutlery used each day started piling up—enough for multiple meals rather than just one or two. The dishes piled up to the point where washing them only once a day was simply unmanageable, and as my back pain worsened, it was a struggle for the whole family. That is why I purchased the LG DUE6BGL3E. This product is a large-capacity 14-place setting model, and since it is a built-in type, it is neatly embedded inside the sink cabinet, making excellent use of space and giving the kitchen a tidy feel. Because the interior is made of stainless steel (metal), it retains odors less and is very hygienic. Along with a powerful steam sterilization function, it features automatic door opening and hot air drying, ensuring that dishes dry cleanly without any water residue after washing. I was also very satisfied with the washing performance. I put things like chili powder, oil, and traces of rice cake soup broth directly into the soup bowls without soaking them first, and most of them were cleaned thoroughly. Thanks to the high-temperature washing and cooling functions, almost no grease or food odors remained, so the dishes felt fresh the next time I took them out. The noise level is relatively low, so it does not significantly disturb the family's rest or sleep, even during quiet mornings or evenings. Thanks to the automatic door opening, there is minimal odor after drying, and internal moisture evaporates quickly, making it feel hygienic. The combination of steam sterilization and hot air gives me even more confidence. Convenience of use is also excellent. The front touch control panel features a hidden style for a sleek look, and the buttons are intuitive. The remaining time display function, which allows you to check how much time is left at a glance, was very useful, and the mid-wash dish loading function, which allows you to add plates or cutlery even during the wash cycle, was also very helpful. In conclusion, this is an appliance that relieves strain on the neck and back after neck disc surgery and significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes caused by the increased use of children's dishes. Water consumption is around 14–15 liters, making it quite economical compared to a 14-place setting model, and with a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, you can worry less about electricity bills. Summary of reasons for recommendation: Relieves back strain: Automatic washing and drying instead of hand washing. Handles large families: Handles large volumes of children's dishes in one go. High hygiene: Steam sterilization + high-temperature washing + automatic door opening drying. Maximized convenience: Touch controls, intermediate loading, smartphone control. Quiet and clean finish: Low noise + water-free drying. Freed from dishwashing, it has become easier to spend time with my children, and the strain on my neck and back has been reduced. If you want a clean kitchen and a hygienic lifestyle, the DUE6BGL3E seems like a truly satisfying choice! If my post was helpful, please press the 'Helpful' button.

The noise level is relatively low, so it does not significantly disturb the family's rest or sleep, even during quiet mornings or evenings. In conclusion, this is an appliance that relieves strain on the neck and back after neck disc surgery and significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes caused by the increased use of children's dishes. Comments (English): [ As expected, it's comfortable. ] || ---------------- || I was going to hire a postpartum helper after giving birth, but I decided to use that money to get a dishwasher lady instead. I bought a dishwasher and I am very satisfied. It sterilizes baby bottles, and I use it for our dishes and the baby's bottles. I think I run it about three times a day. One downside is that it doesn't have a hot air drying function, so there is more moisture left after drying than I expected. Even on the powerful drying setting, there is still a lot of water. However, if I just leave the door open and take the dishes out like a dish drying rack, they do dry. I wondered if it was because I wasn't using dishwasher rinse aid, so I am updating this review after purchasing some. Using rinse aid definitely makes them dry better. If you don't like a lot of water, use rinse aid and leave the door open, and they will dry. But anyway, if you aren't going to use them right away, they will dry just by leaving the door open. I positioned the dishwasher sideways so I can put the dishes in immediately after pre-washing. It is very convenient. The last photo is before I ran the cycle. Baby bottle nipples tend to fly around, so I have to put them in a separate container like that before running the cycle. Otherwise, it will fly around and fall to the floor, making it inconvenient to take out.
