Sentence (English): We LOVED our old Bosch dishwasher and after 13 years it was time to replace it.
Comments (English): [ Not the same as the older models ] || ---------------- || We LOVED our old Bosch dishwasher and after 13 years it was time to replace it. We immediately purchased another Bosch. Oh we were soo disappointed. Despite the great reviews, Bosch moved what I would consider essential features to the app where you could not enable them from the actual dishwasher. Example: Delay start, rinse only, and express wash. But the most annoying change is when it is set for a delayed start, our old Bosch you could keep adding dishes to it and it would start at the delayed time. This new one, you MUST physically press the "start" button every time you open and shut the dishwasher otherwise IT WILL NOT RUN - and kids do not do this. Same if you open mid-cycle. Our old Bosch would resume as soon as you closed the door. This one wants you to press "start" again or it will not resume. And lastly, the app is buggy with it not always connecting to the dishwasher. The troubleshooting guide says to unplug the dishwasher to reset the connection. Sorry but I would have to unbolt it and pull it out, not gonna happen with how often it fails to connect. And given how essential the app is for basic every day running, this is not acceptable. Sorry Bosch, but you had a lifelong loyal customer. But this product was a big let down.

Sentence (English): I recently replaced my old 6-cup dishwasher with a 12-cup Samsung BESPOKE AI dishwasher.
Comments (English): I recently replaced my old 6-cup dishwasher with a 12-cup Samsung BESPOKE AI dishwasher. It feels three times more spacious, and I'm incredibly satisfied with it every day. Before installation, I was worried about space and efficiency, but after using it for a while, I'm so happy I didn't do it sooner. The installation involved removing the existing lower drawer cabinet. The installer was very helpful and provided thorough instructions, so I didn't have to pay any additional installation costs. I ordered the countertop separately online and repurposed the existing drawer cabinet for storage. I'm maximizing the space without wasting it. The Essential White color blends perfectly with my interior, and the luxurious interior when the door is opened brightens up the kitchen. It's also powerful and quiet, so I can use it at night without any worries. Best of all, I'm eligible for a 10% rebate, which I plan to apply for by August, which is another huge plus. This product offers a perfect balance of practicality, design, and value for money. I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person!
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home.
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Sentence (English): Installation: This was truly self-installable!
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Sentence (English): Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose.
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Sentence (English): Honestly, I didn't have high expectations.
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand.
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes even better than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a letdown. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I had to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person!
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself!
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Sentence (English): The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician.
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected!
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

'식기세척기'라는 버킷리스트를 부담 없이 이룰 수 있는 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet.
Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Comments (English): This is a review of the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person! Finally, a dishwasher has arrived in our home. After much deliberation about installation, I finally bought the My Dear Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher 3-Person. I'll share my honest thoughts after using it myself! Installation: This was truly self-installable! Since our house is rented, drilling holes in the kitchen was a bit daunting. But this product is window-mounted, so there's no need for any construction. Just follow the instructions, insert the mounting plate into the window slit, place the dishwasher on top, and connect the drain hose. My husband and I were all set to install it in about 30 minutes. The biggest advantage is that it's self-installable, without the need for a technician. It also saves valuable space, making our small kitchen feel much more spacious. Cleaning Power: It washes more thoroughly than I expected! Honestly, I didn't have high expectations. I thought it would be better than just washing dishes by hand, but guess what? Even dishes with dried rice or greasy side dishes came out sparkling clean. Thanks to the high-temperature sterilization function, it dried quickly, so I didn't have to wipe them dry. It was incredibly convenient to wash all the dishes I used in the morning all at once in the evening, without getting my hands wet. The UV sterilization function also made it safe to store baby bottles and baby dishes, which I'd been hesitant about. Cons: This is a bit of a disappointment. Of course, there were some drawbacks. First, it doesn't fit large pots or frying pans. Since it's for three people, I'll have to focus on smaller dishes like rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. I ended up having to wash the stew pot by hand. And it's not exactly quiet. It's a bit too quiet for running late at night. Of course, the noise of the dishes spinning wasn't annoying, but if you're sensitive to noise, you might want to consider this. Overall: Who would recommend this? I highly recommend it for single- or two-person households and newlyweds. This is a perfect choice, especially for those with small kitchens or rental properties with installation restrictions. While large pots or a large volume of dishes might be difficult to clean, it's a truly effective tool for dealing with the small dishes that pile up every day. I think this is a great product that will help you easily tick off the "dishwasher" bucket list!

Sentence (English): This is a review after 12 months of actual use.
Comments (English): This is a review after 12 months of actual use. When we set up our new home, I invited my aunt to join us. Because I chose the products I wanted and decorated the kitchen accordingly, I didn't have to worry about installation or aesthetics. First of all, my back and shoulders used to get stiff whenever I washed dishes, but now that the dishwasher does the rest, my body feels so much better. It cleans even better than handwashing, and I don't have to worry about residual detergent or dirt. I bought it without hesitation because I heard it uses less water than handwashing, but what I'm even more satisfied with is the reduced time and effort I put into washing dishes. I used to get frustrated when two hours would pass by in a flash between cooking, eating, and washing dishes, but thanks to the dishwasher, I have more time to enjoy life after work, and I'm so happy. At first, I had a hard time because I put in the salt and left the lid on while washing. There's no easy way to drain the water from the salt compartment, so I had to follow the customer service center's advice, soaking it up with a dishcloth, squeezing it out, and squeezing it out. It was exhausting. (Stupid, stupid). I used Hanju Salt from Coupang, and I use Prosh tablets and rinse. Even when fully loaded for 14 people, half a tablet is enough to clean the dishwasher. I usually leave the dishwasher running and go to sleep, but it's quiet and doesn't require the quiet mode. I think quiet mode would be useful in a house with a baby. Another thing that impressed me was that I could continue to use the functions added through the app. I didn't even use the low-temperature hot air mode when using airtight containers other than Ecozen, Tritan, or glass. However, the plastic mode was recently added, so I can use it with confidence.
Comments (Original): 12개월 실사용 후기입니다.신혼집을 차리면서 이모님을 모셨습니다ㅎㅎ 원하는 제품을 고르고 그에 맞춰 주방 인테리어를 했기때문에, 설치나 미적으로 머리아프지 않아 좋았습니다.일단!! 설거지를 할때면 등과 어깨가 결리곤 했는데, 간단하게 애벌세척 만 해두면 식기세척기가 처리해주니 몸이 너무 편합니다.손설거지 할때보다 더 깨끗하게 해주니 잔류세제나 더러움 걱정없어서 마음이 편합니다.손설거지를 했을 때보다 식기세척기를 사용하면 물사용량이 줄어든다고 해서 고민없이 구매를 했습니다만, 더욱 만족하는 부분은 설거지하는데 들이는 시간과 노동이 줄었다는 점입니다.요리하고, 먹고, 설거지하다보면 정신없이 2시간이 지나있는게 속상했었는데, 식기세척기 덕에 퇴근 후 삶을 누릴 수 있는 시간이 늘어 만족합니다.처음에 정제소금을 넣고 뚜껑을 닫지않은채 세척을 하는 바람에 고생했습니다.소금공간의 물을 쉽게 빼낼 수 있는 기능이 없어, 고객센터의 조언대로 행주로 흡수시키고 짜내고 흡수시키고 짜내느랴 피곤했습니다. (멍청멍청)소금은 쿠팡에서 한주소금을 사용했고, 타블렛과 린스는 프로쉬제품 사용합니다. 14인용 꽉꽉채웠을때에도 타블렛 반쪽만으로도 충분히 세척가능합니다.보통 식기세척기를 돌려놓고 잠에드는데, 조용조용모드를 굳이 사용하지 않아도 소음이 없습니다. 조용조용모드는 아기 키우는 집에서 유용하게 사용할 듯 합니다.또 감동했던 부분은 어플에서 추가되는 기능들을 계속 사용할 수 있다는 점임니다.에코젠, 트라이탄, 유리 소재가 아닌 밀폐용기를 돌릴때에는 저온에서 열풍모드도 사용하지 않았었습니다.하지만 최근 플라스틱 모드가 추가되어 안심하고 사용중입니다.

Sentence (English): This review was written about a product provided for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written about a product provided for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. A mini dishwasher that fits perfectly even in a small kitchen! My mother lives alone and recently had shoulder surgery, so I was worried she might have trouble doing the dishes. Large dishwashers are too bulky, and I purchased the My Dear UV Dishwasher because it is easy to install in a small kitchen, takes up minimal space, and can be installed without any plumbing work. I installed it myself, and it wasn't difficult as long as I followed the instructions carefully. You just need to connect the water hose to the window, and that's it. I loved that it didn't take up space on the sink counter. Although it is a 3-person dishwasher, it might be fine for a 3-person household that doesn't use many dishes. However, since my house tends to produce a lot of dishes for each meal, I thought it might be a bit challenging. So, I installed it at my mother's house, and she really loved it. It is so great that it washes and dries everything completely in just 1 hour and 30 minutes! Above all, thanks to the UV sterilization function, I felt at ease not having to worry about leftover water after washing, and it dries perfectly. It will be a great fit for those who care about hygiene. The noise isn't exactly silent, but it wasn't as bothersome as I expected. Also, it uses way more water than washing dishes, so it's economical. Thanks to its compact yet practical features, my mother says her life has become much easier! It’s so great that this dishwasher is proving to be such a lifesaver. If this was helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button!

Sentence (English): Nice Dishwasher but will it last?
Comments (English): [ Nice Dishwasher but, . will it last?  ] || ---------------- || Nice Dishwasher but will it last? my last dishwasher - Bosch - lasted 15 years. I looked at a lot of dishwashers and many seemed flimsy. This seemed better but when I installed it I discovered that the bottom frame - structure - is plastic! You are supposed to put the dishwasher on its side to perform some of the steps to install and there was nothing to grab onto that wasn't flimsy. Even the water and drain connections are mounted on the plastic frame and moved quite a bit while I was trying to connect. The machine gets the dishes very clean but will it last? Just replaced a LG microwave that only lasted 2 years! These things are not cheap and the install is not insignificant. Anybody else out there feeling uncomfortable with the quality of these newer kitchen appliances?

Sentence (English): After 5 days of use the Dishwasher leaked water, flooded on my kitchen floor.
Comments (English): [ Factory default ] || ---------------- || After 5 days of use the Dishwasher leaked water, flooded on my kitchen floor. Water went under my kitchen cabinets. That water cannot be removed from under the cabinets, without the removal of the cabinets, granite counter tops, plumbing and electrical connections. this happened at 9pm in the evening. I flipped the breaker and soaked up as much water as possible. The first thing in the morning I called the STORE. They told me to call their install team. The following day the install tech arrived and accessed the source of the leak. They did not have a part to repair it. They ordered the part and one week later another tech came with the new part. He removed the unit from under the countertop and between the cabinets. He found the cause of the leak. He said that the factory did not fully tighten a hose clamp. He then tightened the hose clamp, started the machine, ran it through a wash cycle and in doing so, he stopped the leak. He did not replace the original part. He took the newly ordered part with him when he left. This is a brand new GE Profile Dishwasher. What a total disappointment. Now I may be faced with wet - damp under the cabinets and there may be a very good possibility that black mold may now be my next headache. Does anyone at GE care what happened to us. the STORE seems to think that it is an unfortunate accident due to a factory fault.

Sentence (English): Our $1,000 Korean manufactured dishwasher (can't name the competitor) was only 4 years old, and had two major failures (of course, both after the 2-year warranty).
Comments (English): [ Good Product: Excellent Install! ] || ---------------- || Our $1,000 Korean manufactured dishwasher (can't name the competitor) was only 4 years old, and had two major failures (of course, both after the 2-year warranty). Cost me another $500 in repairs in year 3 and 4 with motor and drain sensor issues. The top of our previous model also cracked across the surface of the start button (should not happen). Frustrated, we purchased this Samsung after reading a ton of reviews. We are pleased with the product thus far. Only reason for the 4-stars is because we were disappointed that it did not have the fold down tine option (pretty convenient for various dish loading). Also, the very top (third shelf) is missing the ability to adjust for larger items (on one side). Otherwise, a quiet, effective product. Other bonuses are the higher number of cycle options, including a 60 minute power wash. In additon, my wife is a fan of the outer handle, for an extra hanging towel in the kitchen (obviously preference). Costco had this unit $120 off so the price was attractive. We use Costco for all of our major appliance needs. We've had good service with delivery and install over the years. For this dishwasher, I'm giving these technicians 5-stars! WOW! On time. Courteous. Professional. There were 2 installers, working side by side. Installing, measuring, leveling, testing - all while bringing our system up to Costco code standards (we had to update our air gap). Even though Costco adds an extra year of warranty coverage, we opted to purchase the Allstate extended "bumper to bumper" coverage for $89 (covers years 3-5). The lead technician even gave us a number to call for immediate connection and technical support, just in case there's a failure. Absolutely thrilled with the delivery and install experience! Having a large family (15 people when all the kids/grandkids come over), time will tell with the product, but for now, we are sleeping well at night, knowing that we are covered for 5 years. Thank you Costco!

Sentence (English): The GE Profile Energy Star Fingerprint Resistant Top Control Stainless Interior Dishwasher with Microban Antimicrobial Technology is flat-out amazing!
Comments (English): [ Welcome to the Future of Clean ] || ---------------- || The GE Profile Energy Star Fingerprint Resistant Top Control Stainless Interior Dishwasher with Microban Antimicrobial Technology is flat-out amazing! The sleek stainless steel exterior is smooth, elegant, and beautiful which adds to our kitchen's overall aesthetic. It pairs nicely with numerous kitchen designs, whether you're going for a modern or postmodern feel or you're into a more classic or rustic design. This dishwasher effortlessly enhances the overall effect. Upon opening the dishwasher, you get to the easy-to-use touch display on the top of the door and are instantly transported to the future of dishwashing technology. The GE Top Control dishwasher is WiFi compatible and easy to control through the GE Smart HQ app. You can program what type of wash and dry cycle you want from the dishwasher's touch panel or program the cycle of your choosing with the app from anywhere you so desire. You have the option of numerous different wash cycles and can control the wash temperature for more delicate items. The interior of the dishwasher is breathtaking. The light grey trays are coupled with beautiful blue accents and darker grey for the utensil holders. The dishwasher has two main trays with ample room. The bottom compartment is spacious and has plenty of room for plates and pots and pans. The right-hand side has a utensil compartment that runs the length of the dishwasher. The second tray is spacious and can fit all your cups and bottles with room to spare. What's really amazing is that both bottom and top compartment have a spinning blade that allow for water to clean the bottom dishes and the top cups evenly and completely, unlike the older models where you had to rely on the spray from the bottom of the dishwasher and strategically place the dishes and hope and pray that everything would be clean. The two blades make it so that each and every item is getting properly cleaned. In addition, the second shelf has prongs that are water jets that you can place your bottles on for an extra clean experience. Above the second shelf is a third tray for utensils and other miscellaneous items that are too tall to fit into the utensil tray. I love this feature as we have all had the experience of trying to close the dishwasher but the tray won't slide in because your tongs are colliding with the top shelf. This third shelf makes that problem a thing of the past. The final thing about this amazing dishwasher is that the Dry Boost technology helps to get those hard-to-dry items, like plastic Tupperware containers, dry when the wash cycle is complete. Welcome to the future of clean.

Sentence (English): When we moved, we purchased all of our appliances from LG.
Comments (English): When we moved, we purchased all of our appliances from LG. When choosing a dishwasher, we were concerned about whether it would fit snugly under the sink, whether the mop holder wouldn't get in the way, and whether there was a separate place for cutlery and utensils. The BEE6BGE we purchased has a 12cm mop holder, which fits our Hanssem sink, so it didn't get in the way when we opened the door. It also had a separate place for cutlery and utensils, which was nice. As for sink fit, if you check the dishwasher's specifications beforehand and adjust the design accordingly, you should be fine. If you're installing a new sink, make sure the top rails are properly aligned on both sides of the dishwasher when loading it. If you only have one side, the LG installer will advise you to adjust it. You can also purchase salt, conditioner, and detergent through the LG ThinQ app, which is incredibly convenient. I highly recommend trying it out.

Comments (English): [ A great solution for your dishes. ] || ---------------- || Since we've had this dishwasher in our home, the kitchen has breathed new life! One of my favorite things is the third rack, perfect for cutlery and small utensils. It keeps everything very organized and makes better use of the interior space. The LED touch panel is simple and intuitive, even when you're in a hurry. And another important point: it's very quiet; we run it at night and it doesn't get in the way at all. The stainless steel finish gives it a modern touch, but above all, it's durable and easy to keep clean. In short: a very complete dishwasher, with details designed for real life. I would recommend it without hesitation, especially for families or busy homes.

Comments (English): [ Would be a 5 star dishwasher without the app ] || ---------------- || I'm mostly writing this review to complain about the mobile app that they've added to the Bosche series of dishwashers. On older models there was a delay start button that my wife and I heavily used. However on these new models, the only way to use delay start is to1. Create a Bosche account2. Download their stupid app3. Connect your dishwasher to wifi. It's a dishwasher, why does it need to connect to the internet.4. Open the app and schedule a wash with a delay.I could've accepted it as just the price you pay for corporate greed to shove unnecessary features into things, but the "app-enabled" delayed start is so much worse than the old simple button. It takes about 5-10 seconds just to connect to the dishwasher and even then it's finicky and cancels the delayed start a lot if someone loads more dishes after scheduling. I haven't quite figured out why it keeps cancelling the delayed starts when my wife loads more dishes before the start time. I assume it thinks it's open, but it's so hard to debug these kinds of things when you need to schedule it to run at 2 am when you're asleep.Other than that, it's a dishwasher, my wife likes that it's white. It washes dishes alright. I just HATE the stupid app. STOP PUTTING APPS IN EVERYTHING! One good thing to note for parents though is that the painted models are magnetic as you can see in my photo. You don't have the option of modifying how much get used during the cycle. My old one had a dial where I could have a minimum amount released or more. It also leaks from the bottom when not in use. I fill the rinse dispenser and after a few days with the door closed, the compartment is empty. Clearly defective! Did I call or contact GE about this, no! I will refrain from using the rinse aid from now on.

Sentence (English): Worst experience with a Kitchenaid product we've had.
Comments (English): [ A pure mess from installation to repair ] || ---------------- || Worst experience with a Kitchenaid product we've had. Replaced our existing Whirlpool dishwasher to move it into the basement as part of the renovation. The delivery by JB Hunt, which also installed it, was abysmal. The dishwasher was tilted causing the door to open and smash against our cabinets. Then the install left it cockeyed and not flush to the cabinets. The black rubber gaskets that cover the gap from the dishwasher to the cabinet were left with about a 1/4 gap. When the door was shut, the middle rack was left out and now there are dents on the inside of the door. The top rack rail had a piece broken off. The installation team left pieces covered with plastic and styrofoam in the dishwasher that weren't discovered until two days after they left and after they turned it on to check operation.We have no idea why a delivery service is also acting like installation professionals. The people that installed this dishwasher clearly did not know what they were doing. The even took the clips that were part of the previous dishwasher with them and we had to go out and buy new ones so we could have the other dishwasher installed in our basement. While we do like the features of the new dishwasher, and it seems to wash the dishes better and quieter than the previous one, the poor installation service overshadows its performance. Additionally, we called Whirlpool support, and they sent out a team from JB Hunt again, to look at the installation. Even after that visit, the dishwasher is still cockeyed and not flush with the cabinets. The people couldn't address the broken part and then said that the dents in the door compromised it and we would need a new dishwasher.Called Whirlpool support again and the put a service order in with Affordable Appliance Repair. We get the notification that the service will be on the 29th of July. The 29th comes and goes. Call AAR directly and they can't find anything in their system indicating a service order was made. Contact Whirlpool again and we are able to get AAR to come out on the 31st of July. The service tech shows up, aligns the dishwasher a little better but it is still cockeyed and not flush with the cabinet. He has to order the part that broke and says the door dents are just cosmetic. Absolutely they are cosmetic, but we didn't buy a brand-new dishwasher to come with "cosmetic damage". He leaves and we run the dishwasher again after loading it and now it is louder than before.This is turning into a comedy of errors starting with the delivery. We know, eventually, Whirlpool will make this right, the issue is the time it takes to resolve all this when it should have been done right the first time!
