Sentence (English): This dishwasher was purchased as a new home appliance and has been in use for three months.
Comments (English): This dishwasher was purchased as a new home appliance and has been in use for three months. I chose it after much deliberation, but the more I use it, the more I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. It can wash dishes for three to four people at once, and the flexibility of dish arrangement allows for dishes of various sizes. The AI cycle automatically determines the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the water temperature and wash time, which is convenient because it cleans them thoroughly without having to set it separately each time. The washing power is also satisfactory. Even greasy frying pans, glass cups, and stainless steel pots come out spotless and sparkling. The drying function is particularly powerful, so dishes dry fluffy after washing, leaving virtually no water stains. The design, thanks to the Objet's signature calming colors, blends well with kitchen furniture, and the clean front adds a touch of interior design satisfaction. It's also quieter than I expected, so I can run it even at night without any worries. Sentence (English): This is a fantastic dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ An Honest 5 Star review ] || ---------------- || This is a fantastic dishwasher. It is quiet, so quiet that if it didn't have that laser pointing to the ground to let me know it was on, I would think it had an issue. It also connects to my Alexa via homeconnect, it took some messing around with it, basically setting it as a IFTT within Alexa, but once I did, I was able to close the dishwasher and tell my alexa to turn on boschi and that was that. Sounds superfluous right? But honestly its a nice convenience since it has an auto feature that detects how much time it needs to stay on. The app also has other things like power use and water use, which I found interesting but not necessarily helpful. So what about how it cleans? It leaves the dishes spotless. Use the rinseaid! I tried it without it, and I found a few spots. Rinse aid is cheap, and it makes a world of difference, without it you simple don't get what Bosch has to offer. Now the cons/special important information. This does not have a heating element. Instead, it uses some kind of air drying technology that involves very hot water and a "pop-open" door feature, along with the rinse aid to dry. Does it work? Kinda, its dry enough, I would say about 85% works. For example all your cups and dishes will be squeaky clean dry, however, if its plastic tupperware, it will 100% of the time have water left on it, though no spots. I end up rinsing them. Also, any pots depending on the angle may keep some water too. The pop open feature is really nice, though it only works if you turn it on. The drying system has its pros too though, since its not a heating element you don't need to worry about plastic melting or warping, and also it doesn't use up too much electricity. Oh, and the filter, super easy to clean, simple to remove and wash. Oh! 1 more thing! , to install it everyone kept pushing for the Bosch Installation Kit. This is for DYI comrades out there, if you are connecting to 110 standard electrical you only need the cable, and you do need it because its a propriety cable that goes from 3 prong parallel to the standard two prong + ground that goes in US outlets. This may sound annoying, but after installing two different dishwashers, I can tell you it is not only high quality, but very convenient. It simply clicks to connect, and you are done! If you want to connect it directly to wires like a Romex, then you will need the whole kit that includes the junction box. Lets see. oh it comes a one basket for utensils. This may seem like not enough, but it is. I bought my wife two more before even using them since she complained about that, and the new ones are still in the box. 1 is more than enough, also those things take up valuable space.

In some ways, it's a machine that adults need more, but it was inconvenient to have to print it out and bring it to them.

Sentence (English): The most striking feature of this Bosch dishwasher is its incredible quietness.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 Series ] || ---------------- || The most striking feature of this Bosch dishwasher is its incredible quietness. When it's running, you often have to double-check if you've actually started it or check the app. This quietness is particularly valuable in an open-concept living space where the kitchen is part of the main living area. You can run a cycle during dinner, while watching TV, or even late at night without any disruption. Cleaning Performance Of course, a quiet dishwasher is useless if it doesn't clean well, and this Bosch 800 series model doesn't disappoint. It consistently gets dishes, glasses, and silverware sparkling clean, even with stubborn, dried-on food. The adjustable rack and common utensil tray are a fantastic feature, allowing you to easily fit large pots and pans or delicate wine glasses. The third rack for cutlery and small utensils is another thoughtful design that maximizes space and ensures every item gets thoroughly cleaned. Design and User-Friendliness The sleek, minimalist design of the dishwasher fits perfectly into any modern kitchen. The controls are intuitive and easy to use, with a variety of cycle options including a quick wash and an eco-friendly setting. Another great point is that the drying performance. Overall Verdict If you are in the market for a new dishwasher and quietness is a top priority, the Bosch is an outstanding choice. It's an investment that pays off every day by bringing peace and quiet back to your home, all while delivering exceptional cleaning power. It's a rare appliance that you'll barely notice, and in this case, that's the highest compliment you can give.

Sentence (English): After tax, this is a more-than $1,600 machine and it DOES NOT WORK straight out of the box.
Comments (English): [ Truly Horrible ] || ---------------- || After tax, this is a more-than $1,600 machine and it DOES NOT WORK straight out of the box. Altho the installers, maintenance techs, manuals, online forums and Bosch themselves assure me it is working exactly as designed. I will grant, it does all this (not working very well at all) quite quietly. Not only does this machine refuse to actually clean the dishes, it takes as much as 7 consecutive hours to do so—so long any allegations of "power saving energy star" certifications. And only then if you take a series of convoluted and never-disclosed-by-Bosch preemptive assisting steps. There are no actions one can take to impact this machine's deficits besides loading about 1/4 of the capacity and functionally pre-washing all of the dishes by hand. I literally skip two-of-three plate racks, place no more than 15 pieces of cutlery in the basket, never wash anything of any size (no serving platters, no pots, pans, mixing bowls) and never load anything besides pre-washed serving utensils into the upper rack. This dishwasher is INCAPABLE of washing anything made of glass in any capacity at all. Ever. I daily remove and wash by hand all parts of the filtration system at the machine's bottom—I have even replaced these parts—and weekly dismantle and inspect the wash-arms—which are near-impossible to clear of blockages as they do not open. To make the wash work in the pitifully impotent fashion it is capable, I also have to wipe-out and DRY the soap hopper before filling it VERY CAREFULLY and never overfilling it, I must additionally load Dawn liquid dish detergent in the rinse hopper, and add a teaspoon's drizzle to the interior of the wash door before starting the cycle. One must also run the hot water down the sink to assure the machine has immediately-scalding water to pull from the plumbing line in the hope that it will not just run itself for most of the day hoping to find hot-enough water for its computerised desires. One must also run the machine with its filter removed at least weekly so as to clean the cleaning-machine or it will NEVER clean ANYTHING. If I do ALL of these things with the faithful devotions and religious precision of a fourteenth century Monk in Byzantium (and never load any glass, NO GLASS), about 90% the dishes will come out clean about 80% of the time after a five-hour run cycle on the "Eco" mode. My only estimation is that Bosch is selling us name-branded garbage because we didn't order their most-expensive $6000 line. Frankly, I'd prefer huge noise and clanking, 1990s almond colouring, manual knobs, and actual leaks to this imagined fantasy of a "dishwasher." Do not buy this product. Anyone have an olive-green-and-eternal 1970's unit they'd care to trade?

On the first load, I used the Prowash as was recommended in the documentation. At least 1/3 of the load came out dirty. From then on, I've used the Tough cycle, and in every load there are still thing that I feel should be easily cleaned, such as Corelle dishes, or Stainless Steel bowls, plus miscellaneous other dishes and utensils that come out dirty. We have been pre-cleaning everything that has cheese or peanut butter, because they are always a problem. We have also been doing a rinse cycle on loads that will not be washed every day. Still no improvement. But I am very dissatisfied with the dishwasher. That was very disappointing.I also though that the description said that there was a cup shelf, which there is not.I will say I give it a 5 for it's quietness. But overall, I think I made a big mistake.

Comments (English): [ Poor Customer Service - No one answers ] || ---------------- || Purchased our KitchenAid KDFM404KPS dishwasher on 6/25/25 and picked up on 7/3. I started calling KitcheAid and getting someone in Customer Service was a nightmare. After waiting, getting transferred and no one answering, I finally got someone who helped me. I texted a photo and it was agreed that the insulation was wrong. I requested that it be expedited to me since the unit was sitting in the middle of my room. The KitchenAid website info says that it could be either 'high rinse temp drying' or 'extended heating element drying'. No one can or will verify what my model does. As far as performance, the few cycles that we have run, everything seems to be working good. The 3rd level rack is great. I am pleased with the dishwasher. My low lever review is primarily based on my frustration with customer service phone system.I guess I'll get your standard 'sorry about that' response instead of how you're going to address your internal Customer Service problem of answering the phone. At least explain to me what the 'Extended Heat Dry' option does on my model and not the either/or answer.

Sentence (English): We live in a two-room apartment.
Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher, who improves the quality of life ] || ---------------- || We live in a two-room apartment. Our previous house had a really small kitchen, so we didn't even have room for a water purifier. We recently moved, and the kitchen was much larger than before. I'm slow with my hands, so I spent about 20-30 minutes washing dishes almost every morning. It was exhausting, so I bought a dishwasher. I loved the upper and lower blades, the hot air dryer, and the auto door open feature. Since we already have a Samsung washer and dryer, we chose a Samsung dishwasher as well. Since we're renting, we chose a countertop dishwasher. It's small, but it requires a sink to install, and it doesn't connect to the SmartThings app, which is a bit of a shame. For our family, it handles the equivalent of one dinner's worth of dishes, and the noise isn't too bothersome except when the water drains. For things that seem difficult to clean, I briefly soak them in water, then scrub them with a Daiso silicone scrubber and glove before putting them in the dishwasher. It can hold all the pots and frying pans that we use at home, and even a 10-person inner pot. It feels cleaner than washing dishes by hand, and it's so convenient because I can just put them away after dinner and clean up the next morning. I heard that using a conditioner together improves the drying performance, so I use it together. Please keep that in mind!

Sentence (English): I previously had a 12-seater dishwasher, but this time I upgraded to a 14-seater.
Comments (English): [ I'm glad I chose the 14-person option. ] || ---------------- || I previously had a 12-seater dishwasher, but this time I upgraded to a 14-seater. Even though we're a family of three, our old dishwasher always felt understaffed, perhaps because it was an older model. The Bespoke 14-seater has adjustable tray heights, and since there's no separate cutlery holder, I can store cutlery on the top shelf, which is much more convenient. The installers were friendly, and the delivery was on time. I had left space open to install an induction range above the dishwasher, but the installer who remodeled my sink told me the distance between the dishwasher and the induction range wasn't enough, making it difficult to fully install. I hadn't considered raising the induction range before. Sentence (English): The product was great, but the seller was difficult to contact and didn't seem friendly during the call, which was a bit frustrating.
Comments (English): [ great ] || ---------------- || The product was great, but the seller was difficult to contact and didn't seem friendly during the call, which was a bit frustrating. The description page didn't provide detailed information or pictures about shipping and installation costs, so I assumed shipping was free. However, the seller said additional shipping costs apply to rural areas and that I needed to pay a deposit to request installation. Then I noticed a small note. The product page description was incredibly unhelpful! I think the seller should provide clearer information about shipping and installation costs so others wouldn't be as confused as I was. Anyway, despite a shaky start, the installation was very quick. We didn't need to do anything else, so the installation cost was 30,000 won. The installer spent quite a bit of time installing the unit, explaining the process, and even cleaned up after himself. I was worried the color of the unit would be different from our kitchen cabinets, but it matched the color of the countertop, so it blended in quite well. The design was simple, and the instructions weren't difficult to follow. The installer's explanation was sufficient, even without reading the manual. It holds more than I expected, is quiet, and washes very cleanly. I was surprised that the washing time was longer than I expected (including drying), but it was a whole new world. My husband is so happy that he wonders why he bought a washing machine only now. I'm so satisfied that I don't have to worry about washing dishes when there are a lot of guests. And it seems that using the washing machine saves more electricity and water than washing dishes. :) I'm so satisfied with the product that I can't find any faults. This order was made with the hope that the seller would be a little more friendly.
Comments (Original): [ 좋아요 ] || ---------------- || 일단 제품은 아주좋으나 판매자와 연락이 잘안되고 통화상 친절하단 느낌을 못받아서 그건좀 기분이 안좋았구요.  설명페이지에  배송비나 설치비등등 자세한 설명이나 그림같은게 없어서 전  전 배송비가 무료인지 알았는데, 판매자가 지방은 배송비 추가된다며 입금을 해줘야 설치신청 된다하시더라구요. 그러고나서 보니 아주작게 글이 하나있긴 있었는데..  상품페이지 설명이 아주 불친절한것 같아요!!  배송비와 설치비 관련해서 직관적이게 잘보일수있게 첨부해주셔야 저처럼 오해하시는분 없을듯 싶네요..  아무튼 그렇게 좋지않은 시작으로 출발했지만,  설치는 아주빠르게 받아볼수있었구요..  설치비는 저희는 따로  별거할거없이 기존공간 철거만해서  3만원 나왔고 기사님이 꽤오래 앉아서 설치하시고 설명 및 정리까지 잘해주시고 갔습니다.주방가구랑 색이달라서 안어울릴줄 알았는데 상판색상과 같아서 그런지  제법 어울렸고, 디자인도 심플하고..조작법도 어렵지 않아서 설명서 보지 않아도 기사님이 설명주시고 간것만으로도 충분했습니다.생각보다 많은용량이 들어갔고, 소음도 거의없었고 깨끗하게 잘 세척이 되더라구요.생각보다 세척시간이 길어 (건조포함) 놀랬지만 신세계였습니다.  왜 세척기를 이제서야 샀나싶을정도로 넘편합니다. 너무 만족스러워서 이제손님들 많이와도 설겆이 걱정 안할수 있어 좋아요.  그리고 오히려 기존 설겆이보다 세척기 돌리는게 전기세나 물세가 더절약되는것 같더라구요:)  단점을 못찾을정도로 제품은 너무너무 만족스럽고.  판매자만 좀더 친절하면 좋을듯 싶은 주문건 이였습니다~~~

Sentence (English): I live in a 1.5-room apartment. -
Comments (English): [ Electronic devices that buy time ] || ---------------- || I live in a 1.5-room apartment. - Size: Larger than I thought. If you live in a studio apartment with a small kitchen, it might be a bit tricky. I recommend measuring the actual size with a tape measure before buying. - Time: It takes longer than I thought. Washing dishes by hand takes 10-15 minutes, but it takes at least 30-40 minutes on fast mode. Regular mode takes about 2 hours. - Convenience: Honestly, it's convenient. I don't have to get my hands wet, and it's nice that dishwashing detergent doesn't splatter everywhere in the sink. Washing dishes by hand takes at most 10 minutes, but saving that little bit makes life easier. - Noise: It's roughly right to say that you can hear the sound of the windows when it rains. It's not quiet, so I wouldn't recommend using it at night. I recommend turning it on before going to work. - Color: It's surprisingly yellow; it's not a pretty yellow, but it reminds me of a wall-mounted air conditioner in an old house. I wish it was pure white. This is a shame. - Difficulty of assembly: Just connect the drain hose and the water tank hose. Even a kindergartener can do it. - Performance: After eating bibim noodles and leaving it unattended, I just rotated the bowl once and it was clean. However, this is an important part where the detergent performance and how you stack the bowls also have a big impact. - How much can it hold? I put all the items below in at once and rotated it, and it all went in. * 1-person pot (20cm) * Stir-fry pan (28cm) * Glass bowl * Lock & Lock container + lid * Kitchen scissors, 2 pairs each of chopsticks/spoon/tongs, stir-fry spatula * Measuring cup - Rotation frequency: If you live alone, it's probably better to rotate it after eating more than 2 meals. If you rotate it after every meal, the electricity bill will be huge.
Comments (Original): [ 시간을 사는 전자기기 ] || ---------------- || 1.5룸 거주중임.  - 사이즈: 생각보다 큼. 원룸같이 주방이 좁은곳이라면 약간 애매할수도 있음. 무작정 구매하지말고 줄자로 실측 \'반드시\' 해보고 구매하는거 추천.  - 시간: 생각보다 오래 걸림. 손으로 설거지하면 10-15분이면 되는데 쾌속으로 최소 30-40분은 걸림. 일반 모드는 2시간정도.  - 편리함: 솔직히 편하긴함. 손에 물 안묻혀도 되고 싱크대 여기저기 주방세제 거품 안튀어서 좋음. 손 설거지 기껏해야 10분인데 고작 그거 아꼈다고 삶이 편해짐.  - 소음: 장대비 올때 유리창에서 나는 소리가 난다고 하면 대충 맞을듯. 조용하진 않으니 야밤에는 추천 안하고, 걍 출근 전에 돌려놓고 가는거 추천.  - 색상: 생각보다 너무 누래서 놀람;; 이쁜 누런색이 아니라 오래된 집에 있는 벽걸이 에어컨 딱 그 느낌이 남. 차라리 쌩 화이트가 낫지않았을까.. 이 점은 아쉬움.  - 조립 난이도: 그냥 배수호스, 물탱크 연결 호스만 꼽아주면 끝남. 유치원생도 할듯.  - 성능: 비빔면 먹고 방치해서 빨간물 들은 그릇 한번 돌려주니 뽀득뽀득함. 근데 이건 세제 성능도 중요하고 그릇을 어떻게 쌓느냐도 영향 크게주는 부분.  - 얼마나 많이 들어감? 아래에 있는것들 한번에 넣고 돌려봤는데 다 들어갔음.  * 1인용 냄비(20cm) * 볶음팬(28cm) * 유리 볼 * 락앤락 용기 + 뚜껑 * 주방 가위, 젓가락/수저/집게 2쌍씩, 볶음주걱 * 계량컵  - 돌리는 주기: 혼자 살면 솔직히 2끼 이상 먹고 돌리는게 나을듯. 매 끼니마다 돌리면 전기세 어마어마할듯.

Comments (Original): [ 시간을 사는 전자기기 ] || ---------------- || 1.5룸 거주중임.  - 사이즈: 생각보다 큼. 원룸같이 주방이 좁은곳이라면 약간 애매할수도 있음. 무작정 구매하지말고 줄자로 실측 \'반드시\' 해보고 구매하는거 추천.  - 시간: 생각보다 오래 걸림. 손으로 설거지하면 10-15분이면 되는데 쾌속으로 최소 30-40분은 걸림. 일반 모드는 2시간정도.  - 편리함: 솔직히 편하긴함. 손에 물 안묻혀도 되고 싱크대 여기저기 주방세제 거품 안튀어서 좋음. 손 설거지 기껏해야 10분인데 고작 그거 아꼈다고 삶이 편해짐.  - 소음: 장대비 올때 유리창에서 나는 소리가 난다고 하면 대충 맞을듯. 조용하진 않으니 야밤에는 추천 안하고, 걍 출근 전에 돌려놓고 가는거 추천.  - 색상: 생각보다 너무 누래서 놀람;; 이쁜 누런색이 아니라 오래된 집에 있는 벽걸이 에어컨 딱 그 느낌이 남. 차라리 쌩 화이트가 낫지않았을까.. 이 점은 아쉬움.  - 조립 난이도: 그냥 배수호스, 물탱크 연결 호스만 꼽아주면 끝남. 유치원생도 할듯.  - 성능: 비빔면 먹고 방치해서 빨간물 들은 그릇 한번 돌려주니 뽀득뽀득함. 근데 이건 세제 성능도 중요하고 그릇을 어떻게 쌓느냐도 영향 크게주는 부분.  - 얼마나 많이 들어감? 아래에 있는것들 한번에 넣고 돌려봤는데 다 들어갔음.  * 1인용 냄비(20cm) * 볶음팬(28cm) * 유리 볼 * 락앤락 용기 + 뚜껑 * 주방 가위, 젓가락/수저/집게 2쌍씩, 볶음주걱 * 계량컵  - 돌리는 주기: 혼자 살면 솔직히 2끼 이상 먹고 돌리는게 나을듯. 매 끼니마다 돌리면 전기세 어마어마할듯.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Team event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Team event. While preparing for my new home, I was considering purchasing a dishwasher, and thankfully, I was selected for the Coupang Experience Team and had the opportunity to try out the "Mydia Window-Mounted UV Dishwasher." My 16-pyeong (approximately 500 square feet) kitchen is limited, so installing a dishwasher larger than six would have been a challenge. This unit is designed for three people, and its window-mounted design takes up minimal space. It's also easy to install, making it incredibly practical. While it's rated for three, the internal capacity is quite generous, easily handling one or two daily washes for a two-person household. It's easy to organize and organize plates, bowls, cups, and even chopsticks, making for a neat and tidy layout. The combination of high-temperature sterilization and UV functions ensures hygiene, and the complete drying process significantly reduces the worry of washing dishes. I'm also very pleased with the design. The clean white color and minimalist design complement our white-toned home, blending seamlessly with the decor. The product itself is compact, so it doesn't take up much space in the kitchen or storage area, which is a huge plus. It's quiet and intuitive, making it easy for anyone to use. It's also a tank-type dishwasher, so there's no need for a water connection, making installation virtually hassle-free. This makes it a great choice even in kitchens with small sinks. I was worried about installing it myself, but it's incredibly easy—just connect the drain pipe and you're done. Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher, who improves the quality of life ] || ---------------- || We live in a two-room apartment. Our previous home had a really small kitchen, barely enough room for a water purifier, but we recently moved and the kitchen is now more spacious. I'm slow with my hands, so I spent about 20-30 minutes washing dishes almost every morning. It was exhausting, so I bought a dishwasher. I liked the upper and lower blades, hot air drying, and auto door opening features. Since we have a Samsung washer and dryer, we chose a Samsung dishwasher as well. Since we're renting, we chose a countertop dishwasher. It's small, but it requires a sink to install, and it doesn't connect to the SmartThings app, which is a bit disappointing. For our family, it handles the equivalent of one dinner's worth of dishes, and the noise isn't too bothersome except when the water drains. For things that seem difficult to clean, I briefly soak them in water, then scrub them with a Daiso silicone scrubber glove before putting them in the dishwasher. It can hold all the pots and frying pans that we use at home, and even a 10-person inner pot. It feels cleaner than washing dishes by hand, and it's so convenient because I can just put them away after dinner and clean up the next morning. I heard that using a conditioner together improves the drying performance, so I use it together. Please keep that in mind!

Sentence (English): We have now had this dishwasher for a couple of months and wow it has been such an upgrade from what we had previously.
Comments (English): [ Time Saving & Effective! ] || ---------------- || We have now had this dishwasher for a couple of months and wow it has been such an upgrade from what we had previously. We area family with young children so the priorities for us when it came to a new dishwasher were; large capacity, washes and dries well, and is fast and simple to use. Beko has ticked all of these boxes! The large capacity is amazing and the cutlery drawer is a thing of beauty! Even with all of the bits and pieces that a toddler generates in a day we are able to fit our full days worth of dishes into one load which cuts down on our time spent loading and unloading- the cutlery drawer is wonderful for plastic bottle lids and the like! What is even better is that the plastic actually comes out dry! So again we don't seem to have to manually dry the dishes afterwards like our old one! Absolutely love the feature that allows for us to fill up the detergent unit and have the machine automatically decide how much detergent to add. We find we are only topping it up maybe once a week and the result from the liquid and rinse aid seems as good if not better than the tablets we used to use. It may sound like a small time saving but not having to add detergent every time actually makes the whole process much faster and easier. On top of this we find ourselves only really ever using the auto function- so it basically means we just turn it on, hit auto and off it goes! Just on the capacity note, we weren't initially sure what the blue brackets on the bottom basket were for but turns out these fold out to hold your oven trays (also a Beko) so from a usability point of view it just means we are washing less by hand! It went into our kitchen space easily with no modifications needed so perfectly compatible with our existing spot and it just feels so much for solid than our last dishwasher. Amazing work Beko- I would give this six stars if I could!

Sentence (English): This review was written about a product provided for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written about a product provided for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. While preparing our new home, I was considering purchasing a dishwasher. Thankfully, I was selected for the Coupang Experience Group and gained the opportunity to try the 'My Dear Window-type UV Dishwasher.' Since our house is 16 pyeong (approx. 53 sq ft), the kitchen space is limited, so installing a dishwasher for 6 or more people was a burden. However, this product is a 3-person capacity model, and being a window type, it takes up minimal space. It is also very practical because it allows for self-installation. Although it is labeled as a 3-person capacity, the internal capacity is quite generous, so for a household of two, running it once or twice a day is sufficient. If you organize and place plates, soup bowls, cups, and chopsticks properly, they fit neatly and make space arrangement easy. With both high-temperature sterilization and UV functions, I feel confident about hygiene, and since it dries perfectly as well, I was able to significantly reduce my worries about washing dishes. I am also satisfied with the design. The clean white color matches our white-toned home, and Its sleek exterior blends seamlessly with the interior of our newlywed home without clashing with it. The compact size of the product itself is a huge advantage, as it doesn't encroach on cooking or storage space. It is quiet and intuitive to operate, making it easy for anyone to use. Since it uses a water tank system, it doesn't require a water connection, which means there are virtually no restrictions on installation location—a major benefit. Thanks to this, we are using it effectively even in a kitchen with a small sink. I was worried because it is a DIY product, but it is great that all you have to do is easily connect the drain pipe and you're done. Sentence (English): I bought this to make dishwashing easier for my wife and I, who have a baby.
Comments (English): I bought this to make dishwashing easier for my wife and I, who have a baby. I've only had it for a little over a month, but I'll just list all the pros and cons. Pros: It's convenient. The design doesn't overwhelm the kitchen. It's large enough to hold more dishes, pots, and pans than I expected. It's really quiet. I don't feel intimidated by the dishwashing process when guests come over. It's the only one equipped with a water softener, and the automatic door-opening feature is satisfying. Parents can take a break or watch their kids more during dishwashing. Cons: 1. The mode descriptions are unhelpful. - Washing machines don't display information like how many washes, how many rinses, or what temperature each mode will use. However, dishwashers only display the time for each mode—Auto, 1-Hour, Normal, Powerful, and Quiet—making it difficult to tell how long each mode will be washing and rinsing. It's also hard to know what options to add, making it challenging to use for the first time. 2. This may be a personal preference, but the external display of the remaining time isn't brightly lit, so I don't like the slightly dim light. 3. It would be nice to have a dedicated spoon and chopstick holder. It's inconvenient to put them all in the top slot. When I'm busy organizing dishes here and there, I find it faster to just do it by hand. 4. This is a problem with the overall design of the dishwasher, but it's inconvenient to load dishes. Since the dishwasher is generally located at the bottom, I have to bend down to put them in, then stand up again to grab the dishes, which is quite inconvenient. When I'm organizing, I keep having to constantly put dishes in and take them out. I hope the design will be innovative in the future. 5. Even after using the dishwasher, if I close the door tightly, there's still moisture inside, which is inconvenient. 6. Finally, I don't use the steam and sterilization functions as often as I'd like. Also, some dishes don't dry well even with the hot air function. I have a lot to say, but it's also difficult to use. It's not as good as I thought, but I'm trying to use it well.

Sentence (English): I will not purchase an appliance from Costco in the future.
Comments (English): I will not purchase an appliance from Costco in the future. My delivery date was 7/26. I didn't not receive a call or text the evening prior between 6 and 9pm to advise me of the 2 hour delivery window. I called Costco at 7:08 am on 7/26 to inquire and was told I'd get a call with a 2 hr window and then 30 min ahead. At 9:07, I get a text from the delivery/installer saying he could not deliver today but could 7/29 (my birthday) or 7/31. I didn't want to have to wait home for a delivery on my birthday but also couldn't wait till 7/31 since my original 7/26 date had been cancelled by the driver but I scheduled anyway. I called Costco back and asked why they scheduled me for delivery on a day when the deliverer doesn't work. Costco said he had not taken himself off the schedule. I texted the deliverer back and said to please remove himself from schedule if he doesn't work on saturdays. It is a poor reflection on Costco and on his company. On 7/28, I get a text from Costco at 9:28pm saying my machine would be delivered between 9 and 1 on 7/29, not the 2 hour window but a 4 hour window. So I texted the driver at 7:43am to ask if he could come at 11am? I was already inconvenienced by his lack of attention for original scheduling and since it was my birthday, 9-1 removes both breakfast and lunch celebration options. He didn't respond so I went to breakfast with my daughter in law and 11 month old grand daughter. Halfway through meal, I received call from driver saying he'd be there in 20 min and could only wait 10 minutes if I wasn't there or I'd have to reschedule. This is the same guy I texted at 7:43 am that morning with no response. So I left breakfast and flew home in 15 min. He was already there waiting. He installed my appliance. The dishwasher is much smaller than prior ones. I would not have purchased this one had I seen it in person. Costco prices may be good but it's not worth it considering third party delivery/installation and not being able to physically compare dishwashers for size inside. Very disappointed. For my house size, this one is simply too small inside. I don't think you could fit a full family of 4 dishes with meal prep bowls/pots in the space. Very disappointed all around. And after the delivery/installer left, I get a text from Costco that I could rate my delivery and track my package. So I clicked on track my package and of course, it did not show that my dishwasher had actually been delivered and this was after the guy had already delivered. Nothing good at all to report for Costco or the delivery guy. I would return it but quite frankly, with the hassle it was for delivery, I can't imagine the nightmare a return would be.

This isn't a flaw on Whirlpool's part—they accurately listed the decibel level, so just be aware. I'm used to it now and it doesn't bother me.It's a very simple and reliable machine. I always run the normal cycle with heated dry, using Cascade Advanced Power with Dawn (from Costco) and Finish Jet-Dry rinse aid. I also have a water softener, which likely contributes to the great results.
